features.name: TizenTube
features.description: Install official TizenTube Cobalt, keeping any existing installation unchanged. The APK is pinned; its web scripts still follow upstream updates. Channel-list import is not included.
features.manual: Open TizenTube on the TV when ready, then sign into YouTube yourself. Channel-list import is not yet automated.

features.name: Google voice-search handoff
features.description: Keep Google Assistant and send completed YouTube searches to TizenTube. No microphone permission or remote-key filtering. Requires TizenTube.
features.manual: On the TV, enable TizenTube voice search handoff in Accessibility. Google processes your voice. This helper reads completed Google search text; do not enable services you do not trust.

features.name: Proton VPN
features.description: Install the official TV-compatible VPN app. Does not connect automatically or purchase a subscription. Free streaming availability is not guaranteed.
features.manual: Open Proton VPN on the TV, sign in using its QR code and enable Settings > Auto-connect if wanted. A VPN can affect all streaming apps. Approve Android's VPN prompt yourself. Never enable network lockdown before testing recovery.
